question: What happens to the phases when the fire of awakening is entered?
premises: An agent possessing the sixteen named phases enters the fire of awakening.
The phases are slowed by the power of devouring that.
That agent completely releases the phases.
inference: Therefore entry into the fire of awakening by the sixteen-phased power leads to the complete release of the phases.
uncertainties: The identity of the 'sixteen named phases' is technical and context-dependent.
plain_english: Having entered the fire of awakening, the one possessing the sixteen named phases completely releases the phases, which are slowed by the power of devouring that.
